LearnerProfile.title: LearnerProfile
LearnerProfile.description: Preschooler phonics profile, preferences (SATPIN vs A-Z, Hinglish vs English), and overall progress.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in parent/learner account.

childName.description: Display nickname of the young learner.

totalStars.description: Cumulative stars earned across phonics lessons.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

LetterProgress.title: LetterProgress
LetterProgress.description: Per-letter phonics mastery, stars earned, practice count, and best quiz score.

mastered.description: Whether the learner passed the letter phonics quiz.

practiceCount.description: Number of interactive practice sessions completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

StageProgress.title: StageProgress
StageProgress.description: Stars earned and completed activities for phonics course stages (Levels 2-5).

starsEarned.description: Total stars earned in this stage.

completionsCount.description: Number of completed challenges or blends in this stage.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated family's phonics learner profile and preferences.

/users/{userId}/letter_progress/{letterI.description: Stores per-letter phonics mastery and star ratings scoped to the owner user.

/users/{userId}/stage_progress/{stageId}.description: Stores stage stars and completion counts for Levels 2-5 scoped to the owner user.
